examples.title: Quick start
examples.description: The page of the README quick start, exported by @gramlot/gramlot-serverless.
examples.explanation: One module: Page builds the page in a Web Worker of the browser, Logic holds the greeting, which runs in the window.

examples.title: Registration form
examples.description: The page of npm create gramlot page: a form whose data leave the browser through gramlot.inout.
examples.explanation: The data stay in the browser of whoever fills in the form. The buttons prepare an email, save a file that Reload reads back with the exact types, or download JSON.
